name: Mosapride
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 15 mg/day in 3 divided doses; reassess at about 2 weeks; older adults may need 7.5 mg/day

usual_adult_dose.indication: Adjunct to bowel preparation before barium enema
usual_adult_dose.dose: 20 mg at the start of the lavage solution and 20 mg after it is finished

key_interactions.effect: Erythromycin raised mosapride Cmax about 1.6-fold (42.1 to 65.7 ng/mL) and half-life from 1.6 to 2.4 hours (insert 16.7.1).

serious: Fulminant hepatitis, severe liver dysfunction, jaundice (some fatal)

contraindications: None listed in the retrieved insert
monitoring: Liver function and symptoms of hepatitis

pk.excretion_renal_pct: 0.1% unchanged and 7.0% as main metabolite in urine (48 hours)

sources.citation: Nipro Corporation. (2023). Mosapride citrate tablets 2.5 mg and 5 mg "NP" [Japanese package insert, 1st edition, revised October 2023]. Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA), Japan.

revision_log.change: Erythromycin row uses the insert's Cmax and half-life figures (unverified '1.8-fold AUC' removed).
